# Whatsable API errors: refused requests

A tool that fails answers one of these codes, with its meaning and how to fix it. `insufficient_scope` and `feature_not_in_plan` are access and plan, not a fault: say what is missing. A failed send names Meta's code: read it in the WhatsApp error files.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | How to fix | Who fixes it | Retry helps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `idempotency_key_reused` | 409 | This Idempotency-Key was already used in the last 24 hours with a different request body. | Use a new Idempotency-Key for a different request. Reuse a key only to retry the exact same request. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `idempotency_request_in_progress` | 409 | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed. | Wait the seconds in Retry-After and retry with the same key. You will get the first request's answer. | The request or the account must change | yes |
| `template_name_conflict` | 409 | A template with this name and language already exists on this WhatsApp Business Account. | Choose another name, or use the existing template (GET /v1/templates?name=...). | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_waba_not_connected` | 409 | No number of this template's WhatsApp Business Account is connected to Whatsable, so Whatsable cannot ask Meta to delete the template. Nothing was deleted. | Connect a number of that WhatsApp Business Account again, then retry. To remove the template from Whatsable only, delete it under Templates in the Whatsable dashboard, which asks you to confirm. It may still exist at Meta. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_used_by_broadcast` | 409 | A broadcast has used this template, so it cannot be deleted. A broadcast keeps the template it sent, in every status, finished ones included. Nothing was deleted, at Meta or in Whatsable. | Keep the template. To change what it says, duplicate it, submit the copy and use the copy from now on. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `label_name_conflict` | 409 | A label with this name already exists in the organization. Names are compared ignoring case and accents. | Choose another name, or use the existing label (GET /v1/labels). | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_name_conflict` | 409 | Another AI bot in the organization already has this name. | Choose another name, or change the existing bot (GET /v1/ai-bots). | The request or the account must change | no |
| `session_window_closed` | 422 | This is a session message, and the person has not written to this number in the last 24 hours, or never has, so WhatsApp would refuse it. Nothing was sent. | Send an approved template instead (`type: template`), or wait until the person writes to this number again. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_not_approved` | 422 | Meta has not approved this template (it is pending, rejected, paused or disabled), so it cannot be sent. | Wait for Meta's review (GET /v1/templates/{id} shows its status), or send an approved template. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_wrong_waba` | 422 | The template belongs to a different WhatsApp Business Account than the number this send leaves from. | Send from a number on the template's account with `from`, or pick a template of the sending number's account with GET /v1/templates?number_id=<id>. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_not_supported` | 422 | This template uses named variables ({{customer_name}}), which the API cannot send yet. WhatsApp was not called. | Send a template with numbered variables ({{1}}, {{2}}) instead. A broadcast also refuses an authentication template and one with a coupon-code button, which message says: send those one at a time with POST /v1/messages. | Whatsable | no |
| `template_rejected_by_meta` | 422 | WhatsApp refused to accept this template for review, so no template was created. Meta's error code is in details.meta_code. | Change the template (often its name, wording, or examples) and submit it again. A template Meta accepts and later rejects in review is not this error: it reads as status rejected. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `number_not_sending` | 422 | The number this request would send from is paused, disconnected, or still being registered. The API never switches to another number on its own. | Resume or reconnect the number in Settings, or send from another number with `from`. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `contact_has_no_address` | 422 | This contact has neither a phone number nor a WhatsApp user id, so there is nothing to send to. | Add the contact's phone number, or wait until the person writes to you. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `label_limit_reached` | 422 | The organization already has the most labels it may have. | Delete a label you no longer use (DELETE /v1/labels/{id}), then retry. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `free_tier_limit` | 422 | The free plan can message 2 contacts, and this send would reach a new one. | Subscribe in Settings, Billing, then retry. A reply to a contact already messaged still sends. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_limit_reached` | 422 | The organization already has the most AI bots it may have. | Archive and delete a bot you no longer use (PATCH /v1/ai-bots/{id} with status archived, then DELETE /v1/ai-bots/{id}), then retry. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `scheduled_message_not_pending` | 422 | Only a pending scheduled message can be cancelled. This one is being sent right now, or has already been sent, suppressed, failed, missed or cancelled. | Read it with GET /v1/scheduled-messages/{id} for its status. One that was sent carries message_id, the Message it became. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `broadcast_not_cancellable` | 422 | This broadcast is completed or already cancelled, so there is nothing left to cancel. | Nothing to undo: read GET /v1/broadcasts/{id} for what it sent. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `broadcast_not_pausable` | 422 | Only a running broadcast can be paused. This one is scheduled, completed or cancelled. | Read GET /v1/broadcasts/{id} for its status. To stop a scheduled broadcast before it starts, cancel it with POST /v1/broadcasts/{id}/cancel. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `broadcast_not_resumable` | 422 | Only a paused broadcast can be resumed. This one is scheduled, completed or cancelled. | Read GET /v1/broadcasts/{id} for its status. A scheduled broadcast starts by itself at its time; a finished one cannot be resumed. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_not_archived` | 422 | Only an archived AI bot can be deleted, so that deleting a bot is always a deliberate second step. | Archive it first with PATCH /v1/ai-bots/{id} and {"status": "archived"}, then delete it. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_archived` | 422 | This AI bot is archived, so it cannot answer on a number or a conversation, and it takes no new knowledge files or sendable files. | Choose another bot, or bring this one back with PATCH /v1/ai-bots/{id} and {"status": "active"} or {"status": "draft"}. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_file_limit_reached` | 422 | This AI bot already holds the most sendable files it may have. | Delete a file the bot no longer needs (DELETE /v1/ai-bots/{id}/files/{file_id}), then retry. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_text_too_long` | 422 | Adding this text would make the bot's field longer than it may be, so nothing was written. Knowledge holds at most 200,000 characters and instructions at most 80,000. | Append a shorter text. Or read the field whole with GET /v1/ai-bots/{id}/text/{field}, remove what the bot no longer needs, and send the shorter field with PATCH /v1/ai-bots/{id}. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `label_not_available_on_number` | 422 | The label is limited to other numbers, so it cannot be used with the number this request names. | Use a label available on this number (GET /v1/labels shows each label's number_ids), or add the number to the label with PATCH /v1/labels/{id}. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `reply_target_not_quotable` | 422 | The message named in reply_to_message_id was withdrawn, or WhatsApp never accepted it, so WhatsApp has nothing to quote. | Send without reply_to_message_id, or quote another message of the conversation. GET /v1/messages/{id} shows deleted_at and whatsapp_message_id. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `message_has_no_figures` | 422 | The message has no unverified figures to check: only an AI message whose figures were flagged has any. | Pick a message whose unverified_figures is not empty. GET /v1/conversations with figures_to_check=true lists the conversations that hold one. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `message_not_reactable` | 422 | WhatsApp cannot take a reaction to this message: it was withdrawn, WhatsApp never accepted it, so it has no whatsapp_message_id, its send failed, WhatsApp has not accepted it yet (status pending), or it is not a WhatsApp message. | React to a message that has a whatsapp_message_id, no deleted_at, and a status other than failed or pending. A pending message can take a reaction once WhatsApp accepts it. Nothing was sent to WhatsApp. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `channel_window_closed` | 422 | Instagram and Messenger do not let a business write first. This person has no conversation with this account, or wrote too long ago for a message sent through the API, so the channel would refuse it. `details.reason` says which: `no_conversation`, `closed`, or `human_agent_only` (between 24 hours and 7 days, only a person typing in the inbox may reply). Nothing was sent. | Wait until the person writes to this account again, then send within 24 hours of their message. These channels have no templates. With `contact_id`, `channel: last_contacted` falls back to another conversation whose window is open. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `channel_not_supported` | 422 | Instagram and Messenger take text and media only. A template, a sticker, a caption, a quoted reply (`reply_to_message_id`), and reply buttons on Instagram cannot be sent there. `param` names the part. Nothing was sent. | Send the text, or the media without a caption. Send a template on WhatsApp. On Messenger, buttons go out as text with the options listed under it. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `channel_account_ambiguous` | 422 | This API key may send on more than one account of this channel, and the request does not say which: the person has a conversation on more than one of them, or a username could be on more than one account. | Name the account in `from`, with its id from GET /v1/channel-accounts. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `channel_conflicts_with_conversation` | 422 | A message to an existing conversation always goes out on that conversation's channel, and `channel` names a different one. | Leave `channel` out of a send to a WhatsApp conversation, or name the conversation's own channel. GET /v1/conversations/{id}?channel=all reads it. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `username_ambiguous` | 422 | More than one conversation on this Instagram account carries this username, usually because someone renamed their account and another person took the old handle. The API cannot tell who should receive it, so nothing was sent. | Send by `contact_id` or `conversation_id` instead, or reply from the inbox. | The request or the account must change | no |

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/api/errors
